question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank 3.
solution: The correct answer is **"form."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Form"** means to give shape or structure to something, to make or organize something. (कुछ बनाना या संगठित करना (किसी वस्‍तु या कार्यप्रणाली का विशेष रूप; प्रकार)) • **Example**: The artist used clay to **form**__ a beautiful sculpture. • It is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank in the given sentence. • The correct answer is Option 3. • Correct passage: Cancer is a disease in which some of the body’s cells grow __uncontrollably__ and spread to other parts of the body. Cancer can start __almost__ anywhere in the human body, which is made up of trillions of cells. Normally, human cells grow and multiply (through a process called cell division) to __form__ new cells as the body needs them. When cells grow old or become damaged, they die, and new cells take their place. Sometimes, this orderly process ______ (4) ______ down, and abnormal or damaged cells grow and multiply when they shouldn’t. These cells may form tumours, which are lumps of tissue. Tumours can be cancerous or ______ (5) ______. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **"Shape" (Option 1)** means to make something into a particular form. (किसी वस्‍तु को विशेष आकृति में ढालना) • **"Build" (Option 2)** means to construct something, and it does not fit the context of the sentence. (बनाना, निर्माण करना) • **"Formulate" (Option 4)** means to create or develop something, usually a plan or theory, and it does not fit the context of the sentence. (कुछ करने की योजना बनाना या उसके लिए विचारों को व्‍यवस्थित करना; सूत्रित करना) 197:Tf28, The correct answer is **"breaks."**
